children: Pest control that’s kind to your home
Botanical, low-toxicity treatments and prevention-first care — safe for kids, pets and the garden, and tough on the pests you actually want gone.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We treat with plant-derived, low-toxicity products — no chemical haze, no clearing the house for hours after we leave.
Nothing harsh left on the floors, counters or garden where little ones and pets end up. You can carry on your day right away.
Integrated pest management finds why pests are here and shuts it down — so the problem stops coming back, not just today’s bugs.
If pests return between visits, so do we — at no extra charge. We’re not done until your home is genuinely settled.

children: Spraying kills what’s in front of you today. It doesn’t answer why the pests came — the gap under the door, the standing water, the food left out overnight — so a week later they’re back and the can comes out again.

Integrated pest management works the other way around. We find the cause first, close it off, and use the gentlest thing that works. Fewer chemicals, fewer callbacks, and a home that stays settled instead of being sprayed on a schedule.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who GreenShield Pest Solutions is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A lush backyard garden with herbs and flowers along the fence line

children: GreenShield started from a simple conviction: getting rid of pests shouldn’t mean filling your home with chemicals — especially with kids, pets and a garden you actually want to use.
So we built a pest-control company around botanical, low-toxicity treatments and integrated pest management — the kind of results you can trust, delivered by the same technician who learns your home.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every visit starts by finding why pests are here — entry points, moisture, food — not just treating what’s crawling today.
We reach for botanical, low-toxicity products first, and only ever use the least we need to get a lasting result.
If pests come back between scheduled visits, so do we, at no extra charge. The plan isn’t working until your home is settled.
